newsitem.title: USA: Dynamics Research wins $36 mln Ohio deal.
newsitem.headline: Dynamics Research wins $36 mln Ohio deal.

text.p: Dynamics Research Corp said Wednesday it was awarded a $36 million contract by the Ohio Departrment of Human Services.
It said that under the contract, it will provide information technology products and services in support of Ohio's child support enforcement tracking program.
Dynamics Research said it expects a revenue of about $24 million during the first year, installation phase of the project.
The rest of the contract value will be received over a six-year period for support and maintenance services.

The company said it and its subcontractors will provide computer hardware and software, management and coordination of site preparation and installation, support and maintenance and local are network administration training.
Subcontractors in the project are Wang Laboratories Inc, Clover Communications Inc, UCR Inc and Babbage-Simmel, it said.
